lines.zh: 我举着那件器物，慢慢走。
lines.en: I walk slowly, holding the relic up.

lines.zh: 袍子破了，可我还是穿着。
lines.en: My robe is torn, and I still wear it.
The grass withers where I pass.
I walk the ring of stones.
The relic is growing warm.
My steps are slow, like a chant.
I walk and recite.
The wind snaps my hem.
I stop at the circle's center.
The soil is thinnest here.
I hold the relic up to the sky.
My mouth never stops moving.

lines.zh: 器物在我手里转了一点。
lines.en: The relic has turned slightly in my hand.

lines.zh: 石头上的刻痕，亮了一下。
lines.en: The marks on the stones flashed once.
I'm waiting for an answer.
It hasn't answered yet.
I lower my head and change the words.
The wind's down. Good for reciting.
The wind's down. The words carry further.
Changed angle to see clearly.
The grass has all gone flat.
I hear the stones sounding.
The tenth stone is nearly lit.
I'll recite it once more.
This time it should hear.
I hold the relic up and wait.
You're standing outside the circle.
Step into the circle.
This circle was drawn for you.
I waited a long time for a person.

lines.zh: 我手里的东西，你也看见了。
lines.en: You can see what I'm holding.
There's blood on it. Not mine.
I mean to open a door with it.
The door requires a person.
You're the person.
Don't be in a hurry to flee.
The grass outside the circle has withered too.
Run out and it's the same.
Another tear in my ragged robe.
I step back and don't stop reciting.
The relic is still in my hand.
That broke one of my lines.
I start again from the beginning.
Blood runs from my sleeve.
I don't wipe the blood off.
This blood is an offering too.

lines.zh: 血滴在器物上，它应了一声。
lines.en: Blood drips onto the artifact, and it answers.

lines.zh: 你做了什么，你自己知道。
lines.en: You know what you've done.
What's in your hand, put it in.
Put it in the circle.
It needs an offering.
What have you brought?

lines.zh: 它闻到你身上的味道了，别急。
lines.en: It has caught your scent; no need to hurry.
I don't want an object.
I'm waiting for you to lower your guard.

lines.zh: 把你带来的东西放在圈边上。
lines.en: Set down what you brought at the edge of the circle.
Call it a favour to me.
Did you bring the ritual items?

lines.zh: 你撞在我身上，跨进了圈。
lines.en: You bumped me and stepped into the circle.

lines.zh: 你脚下的刻痕开始发红了。
lines.en: The carvings beneath your feet begin to glow red.
The circle takes people itself.
Your feet won't move.
After that, you're still standing.
The circle isn't closed yet. Perfect.
Standing looks better than lying down.

lines.zh: 石头圈的影子把你也圈进去了。
lines.en: The shadow of the stone circle draws you in as well.
The relic is beginning to glow.
See? It knows you.

lines.zh: 召唤我的人，早就走远了。
lines.en: Whoever summoned me left long ago.
I gave myself to it.
It left me nothing else.

lines.zh: 石头上的刻痕，就是我的家人。
lines.en: The marks on the stones are my family.
I say their names every day.
They don't answer.
But they remember me.
These marks are enough for me.
Your question oversteps courtesy.
Let's return to the matter at hand.
I lift the relic higher.
It grows hotter in my hand.
I don't intend to let go.
The heat is a reply.

lines.zh: 我把石子丢进圈里，听它裂开。
lines.en: I drop a pebble into the circle and hear it crack.
The stone splits inside the circle.
The stone splits in my hand.
It needs more.
I pick up your thing.
This belongs to it now.
Someone's stepped into the circle.
Every stone has lit.
I don't need to turn.

lines.zh: 右手一击，我就从方块里出来。
lines.en: One right-click and I rise from the block.
I know every place in the circle.

lines.zh: 你站在第四块石头旁边。
lines.en: You're beside the fourth stone.
The soil is softest there.
I turn the relic toward you.
Now it faces you.
Stay inside the circle. Don't step out.
Moving won't help.
I speak the first line.
The ground underfoot begins to sink.
So do you.
This is very little effort.
I only have to finish.
Three lines left.
Only two left.
The last line. It's spoken.
Finished. It's done.

lines.zh: 我一边念，一边绕着你走。
lines.en: I walk around you as I recite.
Every circuit, it brightens.
You want to interrupt me.
You can't break these words.
I've spoken these words for centuries.
I can say them with my eyes shut.
You've kicked a stone over.
It stands up again.
The circle isn't drawn on the ground.
The circle is here, in my chest.
I point at my chest.
You can't get out.
Not until I finish.
I begin the last passage.
The sound is growing louder.

lines.zh: 你每退一步，石头就亮一块。
lines.en: Every step you give, a stone lights.
The ninth stone has lit.

lines.zh: 第十块亮起来的时候，就该走了。
lines.en: When the tenth lights, it's time to go.
I lift the relic higher.

lines.zh: 地上的影子里，多出几个我。
lines.en: There are several of me in the shadows now.
I aim the relic at you.
A dim light goes out.

lines.zh: 它打在你身上，你的皮在裂。
lines.en: It strikes you and your skin splits.
I didn't stop for a line.
The second is thicker.

lines.zh: 你退了，可圈把你推回来。
lines.en: You retreat and the circle pushes you back.
I raise both hands.
The soil turns over.
Something reaches up from below.
It has you.
I didn't look at any of it.
I keep reciting.
The last passage is finished.
I set the relic down.
I set the relic down on the block.
The marks on the ground light themselves.

lines.zh: 我把袍角压好，风越来越冷。
lines.en: I settle my robe hem as the wind turns colder.
The soil starts to sink.
I stand in the middle and wait.
Wind comes from all sides.
My robe fills out.
The stones rise one by one.
They form a ring.
I raise the relic and walk to the center.
I speak the first word.
The sky dims a little.
Almost there.
I speak another line.
The sky darkens a little more.
It's already outside the door.
It has answered me.

lines.zh: 刻痕从脚下一直烧到墙角。
lines.en: The carvings burn from beneath my feet to the wall corner.
I haven't smiled in a long time.
Now, wait for someone to step in.

lines.zh: 火烧着我的袍子，我照念。
lines.en: Fire burns my robe. I keep reciting.

lines.zh: 我从石台上摔下，器物还在手里。
lines.en: I fall from the stone platform, relic still in hand.
The soil turns to mud and I sink in.
The blast scatters the circle.

lines.zh: 一支箭扎进我的肩，我没拔。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder. I leave it.
Someone is using older words than mine.

lines.zh: 我很久没吃了，也不重要。
lines.en: I haven't eaten in a long while. It doesn't matter.
Lightning strikes the stones and they all flare.
No soil here, and no circle.
